Succession Assessment Policy & Governance Framework (BRD FR-SEL-002, FR-TAR-003):

  • Purpose: Standardize the objective, multi-criteria evaluation of nominated successor candidates across technical banking knowledge, leadership behaviors, proven appraisal history, candidate self-assessment, and executive committee (SPMC) review before deployment into critical banking positions.
  • Configurable Assessment Pillars: Primary assessment components include Written Examination, Structured Competency Interview, audited annual PMS Appraisal, active Succession Competency Assessment, Candidate Self-Assessment, and SPMC Committee Assessment.
  • Calculation Mode: Final candidate readiness can be configured as a Simple Average (equal weighting of active components) or custom Weighted Distribution.
  • Universal Flexibility & Not Applicable (N/A) Handling: Any component can be marked Not Applicable (N/A) for a candidate with documented justification. Weights of N/A components automatically redistribute proportionally across the remaining active components.
  • Pass Mark Benchmark: Candidates must attain a final assessment score of at least 65.0% to be eligible for SPMC successor approval. Scores below this threshold trigger approval blocking.

Written Examination Guidelines: Evaluates banking domain knowledge, credit and risk operations, regulatory compliance (NBE directives), operational leadership, and strategic problem-solving. Scoring is conducted on a 0-100 scale.

Competency-Based Interview Guidelines: Structured executive panel evaluation assessing leadership behavioral anchors: Strategic Vision & Execution, People Development, Stakeholder Influence, Decision Quality, and Integrity. Scoring is conducted on a 0-100 scale.

PMS Integration Rules: The candidate's latest audited Performance Management System score is automatically fetched from the HR appraisal system and weighted into the final score without manual data re-entry.

Not Applicable (N/A) Policy & Guidelines: Any component may be marked as Not Applicable (N/A) for documented business reasons (e.g. lateral executive appointments, pre-verified credentials, or external hires without prior bank PMS). All N/A designations require documented justification. Weights redistribute automatically to remaining criteria.
Technical banking knowledge, regulatory frameworks, risk management, and operational decision-making exam.

Audited annual Performance Management System (PMS) score automatically fetched from the appraisal system.
